136.answer: Severe pain should not be ignored. Please get medical help now: go to your nearest clinic or hospital, or call an ambulance on {AMBULANCE} (or {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from a mobile phone). If you are pregnant, tell them straight away.

137.answer: Heavy bleeding can be serious. Please go to the nearest hospital or call {AMBULANCE} (or {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from a mobile phone) now, especially if you feel dizzy, weak or faint.

138.answer: Difficulty breathing can be a medical emergency. Please call {AMBULANCE} (or {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from a mobile phone) or go to the nearest emergency department now. Do not wait.

139.answer: I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. Your safety matters, and you do not have to face this alone. If you are in danger right now, call {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from your mobile phone or go to your nearest emergency department. You can also speak to someone free of charge, any time of day or night: SADAG Suicide Crisis Line {SADAG} or LifeLine {LIFELINE}. If you can, stay with someone you trust.

110.answer: Please get emergency care straight away if you have severe abdominal or pelvic pain, heavy bleeding, fainting, severe difficulty breathing, chest pain, seizures or any other sudden, serious symptom. Call {AMBULANCE} (or {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from a mobile phone) or go to the nearest hospital.

19.answer: Warning signs include vaginal bleeding, severe abdominal pain, severe headaches, blurred vision, difficulty breathing, fainting, fever, fluid leaking from the vagina, or reduced baby movements after a movement pattern has been established. If you notice any of these, contact your clinic or go to the nearest hospital promptly. If it is severe, call {AMBULANCE} (or {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from a mobile phone).

new_intents.question: What if my baby is not moving or moving less?
new_intents.answer: Reduced or no baby movement needs to be checked promptly. Please contact your clinic or go to the nearest hospital now. Do not wait until tomorrow.
patterns: I haven't felt my baby move

new_intents.question: What if I am being abused or I was assaulted?
new_intents.answer: I'm so sorry this happened to you. It is not your fault, and help is available. If you are in danger now, call {POLICE} (police) or {MOBILE_EMERGENCY} from a mobile phone. You can speak to someone free of charge: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre {GBV_COMMAND} or Stop Gender Violence {STOP_GBV}. If you were sexually assaulted, go to a clinic or hospital as soon as you can so you can get medical care.
patterns: I don't feel safe at home
